detail.title: GW190 Universal Racing Wheel with Shifter & Pedals - 270°
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GW190 is a universal racing wheel featuring a 10-inch diameter with a stylish bimaterial grip for both good looks and confident control through every corner. A full 270-degree lock-to-lock rotation delivers realistic steering feel, while three switchable sensitivity modes — Arcade, Pro and Expert — let you match the wheel's responsiveness to your preferred play style. A dedicated gear shifter stick and customizable on-wheel buttons add depth for genuine sim-style play, while two large pedals with a heel rest and anti-slip base keep footing stable during intense races. Broad compatibility across PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PS4, PS3, Nintendo Switch and Android TV makes it a flexible pick for almost any racing setup.
